minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater hearing to Dec 11 and picked solar then signs bylaws to work on next.
minutes.summary: The board continued the 171 Arbor Street hearing and, after a long hearing with engineer responses and abutter comments, the 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater permit hearing to December 11. Board discussion then set bylaw priorities (water supply protection continuing, then solar, then signs), covered stormwater, sewer and Turkey Hill topics, and approved prior minutes with one abstention.

public_comment.topic: General public comment opened; none offered.

public_comment.stated_role: resident, 290 Lemonster Road, abutter to lot five
public_comment.topic: Large volumes of water cross his property, a swale not shown on plans, doubts the stone diaphragm will cope, little room on the site for added stormwater structures, photo of silted catch basin.
Asked about notice wording of a single family home, number of lots, erosion on slopes, foundation drains, and wildlife.
Street drainage from Lemonster Road past the fire hydrant dumps into lot five; asked the contractor to address it, e.g. with a berm.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing for 171 Arbor Street to December 11th at 6:05 p.m.
Continue the 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater hearing to the next meeting, December 11th at 6:05
Approve the minutes of the 274 Prospect Street public hearing of October 23rd 2023
votes.outcome: passed with one abstention (count not otherwise stated)

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said runoff flooding is a fiscal issue for the town and asked about a stormwater utility idea and task force status.
The school department put forward a 10-year capital plan for Turkey Hill covering ADA, boilers and electrical, with the unknown cost described as millions; debt ceiling limits a new school.

decisions.decision: 255 Sunny Hill Road hearing continued to Dec 11 so the board can consult interim land use director Mr Harris; applicant's site walk with Conservation set for Dec 6.
Board will direct bylaw work to solar then signs, with water supply protection district work continuing.
Members to check with Mr Harris and town counsel on the board's role in the notice of intent / limited project clause, and possibly reach out to the Sewer Commission.
Chair to contact the water district commissioner and constituents about the water supply protection bylaw.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater permit hearing to December 11 by voice vote, so it can consult the interim land use director.
The 171 Arbor Street public hearing was also continued to December 11 at 6:05 p.m. by voice vote.
The board set bylaw work priorities: water supply protection continues, then solar, then signs.
The Chair is to contact the water district commissioner and constituents about the water supply protection bylaw.
The school department put forward a 10-year capital plan for Turkey Hill; the cost was described as unknown, in the millions.

why_it_matters: The Sunny Hill Road permit stays open, so neighbors who raised drainage and runoff concerns can still be heard before the board decides.
The bylaw order of water supply protection, then solar, then signs, shapes which zoning changes could reach a future Town Meeting vote.
Stormwater costs and the Turkey Hill capital needs are future spending pressures, and a debt ceiling limits what the town could borrow for a new school.
